questions.prompt: You want to keep asking until the user types a valid number. Which fits best?
choices: A while loop that repeats until the input converts
questions.explain: You do not know how many attempts it will take, which is exactly when a while loop is the right shape.

questions.prompt: You want to total a list of prices. Which fits best?
choices: A while loop with a counter
A for loop over the list
questions.explain: The sequence is known, so a for loop cannot run off the end or forget to advance.

questions.prompt: Your loop over a list of names prints nothing. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explain: A for loop over an empty sequence runs its body zero times, with no error. Print the length to check.
